extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF prose and Figures 3-6; claims are bounded to membrane-fusion inhibition and structure-guided peptide potency.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LHR-mimetic peptides inhibit retroviral envelope-mediated membrane fusion in a virus-specific manner: Pcr-400 blocks HTLV-1 fusion while PBLV-391 blocks BLV fusion.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=16:Inhibition of envelope-mediated membrane fusion; xml:fig=3:Figure 3

mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is supported by cell-cell fusion inhibition and specificity; the paper does not directly measure peptide-target binding kinetics in this assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: N- and C-terminal regions and conserved leucines in PBLV-391 are required for BLV fusion-inhibitory activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure/prose support loss of activity for tested derivatives; exact IC50 values are not reported for inactive mutants.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The R403A substitution in the BLV LHR-mimetic peptide improves BLV fusion-inhibition potency, consistent with the structural model of charge interaction in the coiled-coil groove.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=20:Substituting an arginine residue for an alanine in PBLV-391 results in a more potent peptide inhibitor; xml:fig=6:Figure 6

mechanism_claims.limitations: The model explains potency but is not a direct structural determination of the BLV peptide-bound state.
